name: NASA's Eyes
oneLine: Landing page for NASA's real-time 3D visualization apps; dark editorial portal, video hero, numbered entry points.

palette.note: Off-black product carousel and long-form app description sections
Secondary sub-nav bar (Eyes Home / Applications / FAQ)
Headlines on dark; the numbered 'things to try' list sits on a white section
Approx. from screenshot: small red circular arrow badge on every 'View in...' link, echoing the NASA meatball

type.note: Bold ~80px sentence-case 'NASA's Eyes', tight tracking; 22px bold section headings
16-18px regular, generous ~1.6 leading, grey-white on dark
12px uppercase with very wide (~0.3em) letter-spacing: 'CLICK ANY OF THESE EYES PRODUCTS...'; also 28px mono numerals 01-05

layout: Hero: full-bleed video, left-aligned headline and 3-line paragraph at ~600px measure, pause button bottom-right.
Numbered list (01-05) with hairline rules between rows on the left 60%, a circular-cropped screenshot with fine-print caption on the right.
Alternating image/text zig-zag rows for each app (Asteroids, Earth, Exoplanets) on the off-black surface.
motion: Background hero video of the ISS over Earth (visible on mobile; desktop captured black pre-load) with a visible pause control.
Horizontal carousel of app chips with circular thumbnails and a next-arrow button.
(inferred) The linked Eyes apps themselves are real-time WebGL scenes; this landing page has no canvas, just video and stills.
interactions: Pause/play toggle on the hero video (accessible motion control).
'View in...' deep links with red arrow badges into specific app scenes.
steal: Pause button on any looping hero animation, bottom-right, for our animated telemetry hero (reduced-motion friendly).
Numbered 01-05 'try this' list with mono numerals and hairline rules for the 'Explore the results' section, each row deep-linking to a specific anomaly.
Ultra-wide-tracked 12px mono overline above each section of the research page.
leave: The dense double nav (global NASA header plus sub-nav) is institutional clutter; our page needs one quiet bar.
Long unbroken paragraphs of marketing copy beside stock-style title-card images; show the real figure instead.

screenshots.caption: Video hero: 'NASA's Eyes' over Mars descent, pause button
Numbered 01-05 list beside circular Cassini screenshot
Zig-zag app rows with red arrow links
Mobile hero, stacked app entry points
